intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise. Sip champagne while watching the sky turn shades of orange and pink over the Indian Ocean. Many resorts offer this as a signature romantic experience, perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate moment on the water.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and colorful soft corals. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels and offers breathtaking underwater scenery just a short boat ride from Malé. Guided snorkeling tours ensure you spot the best marine life safely.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual set over the turquoise lagoon in a glass-floored overwater treatment pavilion. Enjoy traditional Maldivian coconut oil massages, flower baths, and aromatherapy scrubs while listening to the gentle lapping of the ocean below. This quintessential luxury experience is a must for honeymooners seeking ultimate relaxation.
experiences.location: South Malé Atoll, Olhuveli or Anantara Dhigu Resort

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Local Cuisine Tasting
experiences.description: Dive into the rich culinary culture of the Maldives with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa short eats. Finish with a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach featuring your freshly prepared Maldivian feast paired with tropical fruit juices.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Wade into the warm Indian Ocean after dark to witness the magical phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the water with an ethereal blue glow. This rare and romantic natural spectacle is one of the most unforgettable experiences in the Maldives, perfect for honeymooners. A guided naturalist accompanies you to ensure safety and explain the science behind this natural wonder.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, and arrange speedboat or local ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort bar before heading to bed.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight or airport snack
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in-flight meal
meals.dinner: Light late-night snack at the resort's 24-hour service or grab a quick bite from the airport food court before departure (budget-friendly local options available at MLE airport)

day_by_day.notes: Keep your transfer details handy — confirm speedboat or ferry timing with the resort in advance. Pack a light carry-on snack for the late arrival. Exchange a small amount of USD at the airport for local tips and small purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, enjoy breakfast at the resort. Take a relaxed stroll along the beachfront to get oriented with the resort layout, the house reef location, and nearby facilities. Dip your toes in the turquoise lagoon and watch the sunrise if energy allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a basic snorkel set from the resort's water sports center (budget tip: ask about complimentary gear included with your room package). Head to the house reef for your first snorkeling session — explore vibrant coral gardens and spot parrotfish, clownfish, and sea turtles in the shallow lagoon. Spend 1–2 hours in the water before relaxing on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the beachfront — find a quiet spot on the sand with your partner for a romantic golden-hour moment. Head to the resort's casual dining outlet for dinner. Ask staff about any local guesthouses or budget eateries nearby on the island for future meals.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet — included if part of your package, or opt for a lighter à la carte option to save costs
meals.lunch: Pack snacks from a local shop or grab a simple sandwich/fruit plate from the resort's casual snack bar
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — order set menus or daily specials which are more budget-friendly than à la carte; budget approximately $15–$25 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: This is your orientation day — keep it relaxed. Confirm with the resort what water sports equipment is complimentary. Ask the front desk about free or low-cost island activities for the coming days.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef before the crowds arrive — the water is calmest and clearest in the morning. Look for reef sharks, manta rays, and colorful reef fish. Bring an underwater disposable camera or use a waterproof phone case for photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local island on foot or by bicycle (rent from the resort for approximately $5–$10/day). Visit the local community areas, small shops, and any public beaches. Pick up fresh tropical fruits, local snacks, and bottled water from a local convenience store to save on meal costs throughout the trip.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach picnic at sunset — purchase fresh fruits, local bread, and snacks from the island shop and set up a simple picnic on the beachfront. Bring a sarong or beach mat. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean for a magical, budget-friendly romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local teashop breakfast — roshi (flatbread) with tuna curry is a traditional Maldivian budget breakfast for under $3
meals.lunch: Local island café or guesthouse restaurant — hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats) platter with tea, approximately $4–$7 per person
meals.dinner: DIY beach picnic with local snacks, fresh fruit, and drinks purchased from the island shop — budget approximately $8–$12 for two people

day_by_day.notes: Maldivian local islands have modest dress codes away from resort beaches — carry a sarong or light cover-up when exploring the community areas. Respect local customs and prayer times.

day_by_day.morning: Join a shared group snorkeling excursion organized by the resort or a local dive center — group tours are significantly cheaper than private charters. Visit a nearby coral reef or sandbank known for marine life. Look for nurse sharks, eagle rays, and sea turtles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby uninhabited sandbank (sandbank excursions via shared boat are typically $20–$35 per person). Spend the afternoon swimming in crystal-clear waters, sunbathing on pristine white sand, and enjoying the ultimate Maldives experience on a budget. Bring your own snacks and water.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couples' sunset walk along the water's edge. Visit the resort bar for a single signature cocktail to share — a romantic, budget-conscious splurge. Watch the bioluminescent plankton light up the shoreline after dark if conditions are right (March is a good month for this).

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fuel up well before the day's excursions
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic lunch for the sandbank — buy bread, canned tuna, fruits, and water from the local shop the night before
meals.dinner: Local guesthouse restaurant on the island — grilled fish with rice and salad, approximately $8–$15 per person; ask locals for recommendations

day_by_day.notes: Book the sandbank and snorkeling excursion through a local operator rather than the resort to save 30–50% on pricing. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water for the sandbank trip.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation on the beach — many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost sunrise yoga sessions. If not available, practice independently on the quiet beachfront at dawn. Follow with a swim in the lagoon and a slow, romantic breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the underwater world with a guided snorkeling trip to a nearby dive site famous for coral gardens. Alternatively, try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) in the calm lagoon — typically $10–$15/hour rental. Enjoy the turquoise waters and stunning views of the resort island from the water.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a budget-friendly romantic dinner on the beach — contact the resort in advance to see if they offer a simple beach dinner setup (some resorts do this at a lower cost than formal private dining). Alternatively, dine at a casual beachside table at the resort restaurant and request a table closest to the water.

meals.breakfast: Slow resort breakfast — treat yourselves to a slightly more indulgent breakfast today; fresh tropical fruit platter, eggs, and local coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort snack bar — fresh coconut, grilled corn, and a fruit smoothie; budget $6–$10
meals.dinner: Beachside dinner at the resort — order the catch of the day (fresh fish is always the best value and freshest option in the Maldives); budget $20–$30 per person

day_by_day.notes: Fresh coconut water from local vendors is one of the best budget refreshments in the Maldives — typically $1–$2 and extremely hydrating. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Take a local public ferry to a neighboring local island (ferry tickets are extremely affordable — typically $1–$3 USD). Explore a different island's culture, visit the local market, and interact with Maldivian residents. This is one of the most authentic and budget-friendly experiences in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the neighboring island — visit the local Friday Mosque (if open to visitors), browse handmade crafts and lacquerwork at local shops, and enjoy the laid-back island atmosphere. Purchase affordable souvenirs such as woven mats, lacquer boxes, or local spices.
day_by_day.evening: Return via ferry to your resort island before sunset. Rest and freshen up, then enjoy a quiet evening strolling the resort beachfront hand-in-hand. Stargaze from the beach — the Maldives has minimal light pollution and offers spectacular night skies.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before catching the ferry
meals.lunch: Lunch at a local teashop on the neighboring island — traditional Maldivian rice and curry with fresh fish, approximately $3–$6 per person; an authentic and incredibly affordable meal
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort — try the set dinner menu for better value; budget $15–$20 per person

day_by_day.notes: Check the public ferry schedule in advance — ferries run on fixed schedules and may be limited. Dress modestly when visiting local islands (shoulders and knees covered). This is one of the best budget travel tips for the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest and relaxation day. Sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Lounge on the beachfront with a good book, swim in the lagoon, and simply soak in the paradise surroundings. This is your honeymoon — embrace the luxury of doing nothing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling session at a different section of the house reef to discover new marine life. Try to spot octopus, moray eels, and lionfish in the coral crevices. Take an afternoon nap in a beach lounger under a palm tree.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourselves to a special mid-trip romantic experience — arrange a sunset cruise with a local operator (shared dhoni boat sunset cruise typically costs $25–$40 per person and includes snacks and soft drinks). Watch the sun dip below the horizon from the water.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast if your package allows, or a leisurely resort buffet — enjoy a romantic, unhurried morning meal
meals.lunch: Simple beach lunch — fresh fruit, sandwiches, and cold drinks from the resort snack bar; budget $8–$12
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant dinner — celebrate the halfway point of your trip with a slightly more indulgent meal; share a dessert for a romantic touch; budget $25–$35 for two

day_by_day.notes: This is your rest day — resist the urge to over-plan. The Maldives is best experienced slowly. Use this day to recharge for the second half of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching excursion — shared group tours depart at sunrise and typically cost $30–$50 per person. Spinner dolphins are commonly seen in the waters around the Maldives in March. An unforgettable and romantic experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the excursion and enjoy a late morning swim. After lunch, visit the resort's spa for a single couples' treatment — look for promotional packages or shorter treatment options (foot massage or head massage) to keep costs manageable; budget $40–$80 for a shared session.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet, romantic evening on the beachfront. Write postcards to family and friends from your honeymoon destination. Watch the night sky and listen to the gentle lapping of the ocean waves.

meals.breakfast: Light early breakfast before the dolphin excursion — grab a banana, toast, and coffee from the resort
meals.lunch: Late brunch at the resort upon return — eggs, fresh juice, and local pastries; budget $10–$15
meals.dinner: Local guesthouse restaurant or resort casual dining — grilled lobster or fresh tuna steak is a splurge worth considering once during the trip; budget $20–$30 per person

day_by_day.notes: Book the dolphin watching tour through a local operator for the best price. March is an excellent month for dolphin sightings as the seas are generally calm. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens or waterproof case.

day_by_day.morning: Beginner snorkeling lesson or guided underwater photography session — some resorts and dive centers offer affordable introductory sessions. Alternatively, explore a new snorkeling spot recommended by the resort staff. Focus on underwater photography using your waterproof device.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach day — set up on the most secluded part of the beachfront with snacks and drinks. Build sandcastles, play in the waves, and simply enjoy being in paradise together. Collect interesting shells and coral fragments as natural souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Cooking class or local food demonstration — ask the resort or local community center if they offer any affordable Maldivian cooking experiences. Learn to make traditional dishes like garudhiya (tuna broth) or mas huni (shredded tuna with coconut). A fun and culturally enriching evening activity.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — stock up well for an active morning
meals.lunch: Picnic on the beach — prepare simple sandwiches and snacks from supplies purchased at the local shop; budget $5–$8
meals.dinner: Cooking class dinner (if available) or resort restaurant — enjoy the fruits of your cooking lesson or order Maldivian specialties from the menu; budget $12–$20 per person

day_by_day.notes: Ask resort staff about hidden or less-visited snorkeling spots — staff often know the best local secrets that aren't advertised to tourists. These spots often have better marine life and fewer crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise kayaking in the lagoon — rent a double kayak from the resort water sports center (approximately $10–$15/hour) and paddle out to watch the sunrise over the Indian Ocean together. A deeply romantic and budget-friendly morning activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fish market on a nearby island (accessible by short ferry or boat) — watch the traditional fishing boats return with their catch and observe the vibrant local trading scene. Purchase fresh fish directly from fishermen for an incredibly affordable price if you have access to cooking facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic beach evening — lay out a blanket on the sand and stargaze. The Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world, and March skies are typically clear. Look for constellations, shooting stars, and the Milky Way.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before kayaking — fruit, yogurt, and coffee
meals.lunch: Local island café near the fish market — fresh grilled fish with rice and coconut salad, approximately $5–$8 per person
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — treat yourselves to a slightly elevated dining experience; share a bottle of local fruit juice or mocktail; budget $20–$28 per person

day_by_day.notes: Double kayaks are perfect for couples and offer a wonderful shared experience. Paddle gently and look down through the clear water — you can often see fish and coral from the kayak without even getting in the water.

day_by_day.morning: Final full-day snorkeling adventure — join a half-day shared snorkeling tour visiting two or three different reef sites around the atoll. This is your last major water activity, so make it count. Look for whale sharks if the season aligns (March can be good for whale shark sightings in some atolls).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the snorkeling tour and spend the afternoon relaxing, swimming, and taking final photos of the resort, beach, and lagoon. Begin mentally preparing for departure while soaking in every last moment of paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Special farewell romantic dinner — this is the night to splurge slightly more than usual. Choose the best dining option available at the resort or a recommended restaurant, dress up, and celebrate your honeymoon with a memorable meal. Toast to your trip with a signature mocktail or local drink.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — eat well before the snorkeling excursion
meals.lunch: Snacks on the boat during the snorkeling tour — bring your own fruit and water to save costs
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — budget $35–$50 for two as a once-trip splurge; order fresh seafood and a dessert to share

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to purchase any remaining souvenirs — local lacquerwork, Maldivian woven products, and dried fish are popular and affordable. Avoid resort gift shops for souvenirs and instead shop at local island stores for much better prices.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise swim in the lagoon — wake up early for one last magical moment in the turquoise waters. Take photos and videos to capture the memories. Collect a small vial of sand from the beach as a keepsake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out from Aegean Bliss Resort (confirm checkout time with reception). Store luggage at the resort while you enjoy a final few hours on the island. Take a final walk around the resort grounds, say goodbye to staff who made your stay special, and enjoy one last coconut on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange transfer to Velana International Airport (Male). Arrive at the airport with sufficient time for check-in and security. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian honey, local tea, and small crafts make excellent affordable souvenirs. Enjoy a final Maldivian meal at the airport.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy every last bite of your Maldives holiday breakfast
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a local café or the resort snack bar before checkout
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or café — local Maldivian dishes available at the airport; budget $10–$18 per person

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your return flight details and transfer timing carefully. Allow extra time for the speedboat or ferry transfer to Male — these can be affected by weather and tidal conditions. Keep important documents, valuables, and a change of clothes in your carry-on.

day_by_day.morning: Departure day — if your flight departs in the morning, ensure you are at the airport well in advance. Use any remaining local currency on snacks, drinks, or last-minute souvenirs at the airport. Reflect on 13 incredible days in the Maldives and begin planning your next adventure together.
day_by_day.afternoon: In-flight or at transit airport — rest, review your photos, and relive the memories of your honeymoon. Begin organizing your favorite photos for a honeymoon photo album or social media sharing.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home — bring back the spirit of the Maldives with you. Recreate a Maldivian-inspired dinner at home using recipes learned during your trip, and continue celebrating your honeymoon long after returning.

meals.breakfast: Airport breakfast or early resort breakfast if departing late morning — use remaining local currency
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or transit airport food court
meals.dinner: In-flight or at home — a celebratory homecoming meal

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tip: By using local ferries, shared excursions, local island restaurants, and self-catering for some meals, a couple can experience the Maldives on a budget of approximately $100–$150 USD per day (excluding accommodation), while still enjoying romantic, memorable honeymoon experiences. The Maldives on a budget is absolutely possible — the natural beauty is free.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Meet resort transfer representative and board speedboat or seaplane transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to Beachfront accommodation, enjoy a welcome drink and light snack prepared by the resort. Settle in and rest.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack and tropical fruit platter provided by Aegean Bliss Resort upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat transfer timing with resort in advance as late-night arrivals may require a pre-arranged night transfer. Pack snacks for the journey as airport dining options may be limited after 10 PM. Keep essentials in carry-on for easy access upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort's main restaurant overlooking the lagoon. Take a slow morning walk along the beachfront to get oriented with the resort grounds and soak in your first Maldivian sunrise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's house reef with a complimentary snorkel set from the water sports center. Spend 1–2 hours discovering the colorful marine life just steps from your beachfront villa. Return to the beach for relaxation with a good book and a fresh coconut drink.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean and toast to the beginning of your honeymoon adventure.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — included or mid-range resort rate (~$20–30 per person)
meals.lunch: Casual beach grill at the resort — grilled fish, salads, and fresh juices (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Beachfront à la carte dinner at the resort restaurant — seafood platter and local Maldivian curries (~$50–70 per person)

day_by_day.notes: This is an intentional slow day to recover from jet lag and long travel. Drink plenty of water and apply sunscreen before heading to the beach. Visit the resort's activities desk to pre-book experiences for the coming days.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef excursion — one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites. Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and schools of tropical fish. The guided boat trip typically departs at 8:30 AM and lasts 2–3 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed lunch. Spend the afternoon unwinding on your private beachfront stretch — read, nap, or simply float in the warm turquoise lagoon. Optional: visit the resort's infinity pool for a change of scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board a traditional flower-and-candle-decorated Maldivian wooden dhoni boat for a private romantic cruise. Sip chilled champagne as the sun melts into the horizon painting the sky in gold and pink.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast before the early morning snorkeling departure
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort beach café — fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit bowls, and smoothies (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner on board the dhoni cruise or back at the resort's overwater restaurant upon return — fresh grilled catch of the day (~$55–75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef is a UNESCO-protected marine area — do not touch corals or feed fish. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, an underwater camera or GoPro, and a light rash guard. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours; book through the resort's concierge at least one day in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two — indulge in a luxurious couples' spa ritual set over the turquoise lagoon in a glass-floored overwater treatment room. Enjoy traditional Maldivian healing techniques, aromatic oils, and synchronized massages with ocean views beneath your feet. Session typically lasts 90–120 minutes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-spa glow afternoon: lounge in your beachfront villa's private terrace or hammock. Take a gentle swim in the calm lagoon. Optional: browse the resort boutique for local crafts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the resort's dining options for a special romantic dinner. Choose a table set on the beach with lanterns and flower petals for a honeymoon setup (request in advance). Enjoy Maldivian-inspired tasting menus with fresh seafood.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast delivery — tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and Maldivian black tea (~$30–40 per person, or included in some packages)
meals.lunch: Light poolside snacks and fresh juices at the resort pool bar (~$15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Special romantic beach dinner setup at the resort — 3-course set menu with Maldivian lobster, tuna tataki, and coconut desserts (~$70–90 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Overwater Spa Treatment well in advance as couple slots fill quickly, especially for honeymooners. Inform the spa of any allergies or physical conditions beforehand. Ask the concierge to arrange a romantic beach dinner setup with advance notice of at least 24 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach (complimentary or low-cost through the resort's wellness program). Follow with a refreshing morning swim in the lagoon. Enjoy a slow breakfast with ocean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cooking Class and Local Cuisine Tasting — dive into the island's rich culinary culture with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth), and roshi (flatbread). Taste your creations for lunch.
day_by_day.evening: Take a leisurely evening stroll along the beach as the sky transitions to twilight. Enjoy cocktails at the resort's sunset bar before heading to dinner. Try the local Maldivian-inspired dishes you learned to cook earlier.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, eggs, Maldivian short eats, and coffee
meals.lunch: Your own creations from the cooking class! Typically included in the cooking class experience (~$60–80 per person for the class and meal)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's à la carte restaurant — order traditional Maldivian fish curry and coconut rice (~$40–55 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is a wonderful cultural immersion experience and a fun honeymoon activity. Request a private class for a more intimate experience. Take photos of recipes and techniques to recreate at home. Vegetarian options are usually available upon request.

day_by_day.morning: Full day excursion: Take a resort-organized speedboat trip to a nearby local inhabited island (such as Maafushi or a local village island) to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Walk through the island's narrow streets, visit the local mosque, and browse small shops selling handmade crafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the local island — enjoy a simple local lunch at a small café. Visit the island's public beach and snorkel in the surrounding waters. Purchase locally made lacquerware, woven mats, or shell jewelry as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by speedboat before sunset. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet evening at the resort. Relax on your private beach terrace with a bottle of wine.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Local island café — fresh tuna sandwiches, short eats, and fresh lime juice (~$8–15 per person — very affordable local pricing)
meals.dinner: Resort dinner at the main restaurant — grilled mahi-mahi with tropical salsa and coconut rice (~$45–65 per person)

day_by_day.notes: When visiting local inhabited islands, dress modestly out of respect for Islamic culture — cover shoulders and knees. Bikinis are only permitted on designated tourist beaches. Bring cash (USD or MVR) as local islands may not accept cards. The speedboat excursion is typically organized through the resort's activities desk.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint relaxation day — sleep in and enjoy a slow morning. Order in-villa breakfast and spend the morning in your private beachfront space. Take a long, uninterrupted swim in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience preparation day — rest and recharge in the afternoon. Enjoy the resort's facilities: infinity pool, beach loungers, and complimentary watersports like kayaking or paddleboarding.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — wade into the warm Indian Ocean after dark to witness the magical phenomenon of glowing bioluminescent plankton. Every movement in the water creates streaks of electric blue light. A truly once-in-a-lifetime romantic experience lasting approximately 1.5–2 hours.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — fresh fruit platter, yogurt, granola, croissants, and Maldivian tea (~$30–40 per person)
meals.lunch: Beach grill lunch — grilled snapper, tropical salad, and fresh coconut water (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Pre-snorkeling light dinner at the resort — pasta with seafood, salad, and dessert (~$40–55 per person). Avoid heavy meals immediately before the night swim.

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent experience is weather and season dependent — plankton blooms are most visible on darker, calmer nights away from artificial light. Your guide will lead the experience safely. Do not use flash photography as it disrupts the plankton. This is one of the most magical experiences of the trip — allow yourself to be fully present.

day_by_day.morning: Morning dolphin watching cruise — join a resort-organized early morning boat excursion to spot spinner dolphins in the open ocean. These playful dolphins are commonly seen leaping and spinning around boat bows in Maldivian waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for lunch. Spend a leisurely afternoon snorkeling the house reef independently, looking for sea turtles, reef sharks, and colorful nudibranchs. Take an underwater camera to capture the marine life.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-villa dinner experience — arrange with the resort to have a private dinner set up on your beachfront terrace with candles, flowers, and a personalized menu. A butler or private chef can serve a multi-course meal under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the early morning dolphin cruise — pastries, fruit, and coffee at the resort café
meals.lunch: Resort beach café — fish tacos, grilled corn, fresh juices (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Private in-villa romantic dinner — 4-course menu with champagne, lobster thermidor, and chocolate fondant (~$100–130 per person, a splurge-worthy special evening)

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed as these are wild animals, but spinner dolphins are very commonly encountered in the Maldives. The private in-villa dinner is a highlight for honeymooners — book at least 2 days in advance and communicate any dietary preferences or allergies to the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Morning visit to a sandbank — take a short speedboat ride to a pristine uninhabited sandbank (a tiny strip of white sand surrounded by turquoise ocean). Enjoy a private picnic breakfast set up by the resort on the sandbank. Snorkel the surrounding waters and feel completely alone in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort. Enjoy a refreshing afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with tropical cocktails. Optionally, book a standalone 60-minute relaxation massage at the spa to rejuvenate.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's cultural evening — many Maldivian resorts host traditional Bodu Beru drum performances (traditional island music and dance). Enjoy the vibrant rhythms while sipping cocktails at the outdoor lounge.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank picnic breakfast — fresh fruits, pastries, smoked salmon, juices, and champagne (arranged by resort, ~$50–70 per person)
meals.lunch: Poolside light bites — nachos, fresh salads, and tropical smoothies (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Cultural dinner evening at the resort — themed Maldivian buffet with traditional dishes, grilled meats, and seafood (~$45–65 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic is one of the most iconic Maldivian experiences and perfect for honeymoon photos. Bring reef-safe sunscreen as sandbanks offer no shade. Request the resort to arrange this at least one day ahead. Sandbank availability depends on tides and weather conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Guided snorkeling tour to a different reef site — explore a new coral reef ecosystem with a resort marine biologist or guide. Learn about coral conservation efforts and spot different species than Banana Reef offered. Many resorts in the Maldives have coral restoration programs you can participate in.
day_by_day.afternoon: Free afternoon — your choice of activities. Options include: stand-up paddleboarding in the lagoon, beach volleyball, reading on a hammock, or visiting the resort's gift shop. Take a long nap if needed.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or alternatively enjoy sundowners at the resort's overwater bar with panoramic views of the Indian Ocean horizon. Watch the stars emerge and enjoy the peaceful ambiance.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — full spread with international and Maldivian options
meals.lunch: Resort restaurant — fresh grilled barracuda with lemon butter, roasted vegetables, and iced tea (~$30–45 per person)
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant dinner at the resort — sushi and sashimi platter with local tuna, miso soup, and green tea ice cream (~$55–75 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort's marine biologist about the health of local coral reefs and how to be a responsible snorkeler. Participate in a coral planting activity if available — a meaningful way to give back to the ocean ecosystem. Avoid touching, standing on, or kicking corals at any time.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure morning — final full spa day. Book individual treatments: a Maldivian herbal body wrap, a hot stone massage, or a traditional Javanese lulur scrub. Spend 2–3 hours in the spa's relaxation facilities including steam room and plunge pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack a beach bag and spend the final full beach afternoon making the most of the Maldivian sun. Swim, snorkel the house reef one last time, and collect memories. Take photos of the beachfront villa and surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Special anniversary/honeymoon dinner — ask the resort to arrange a table with rose petals, a personalized cake, and a bottle of sparkling wine. Celebrate your journey and each other with a meaningful final evening meal.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — eggs benedict, fresh tropical fruit, pastries, and Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Beach café lunch — lobster roll, sweet potato fries, and fresh lemonade (~$35–50 per person)
meals.dinner: Celebratory honeymoon dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — 5-course tasting menu with wine pairing (~$90–120 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance about any honeymoon celebration so they can prepare special touches like a personalized cake or room decoration. This is a great evening to reflect on the trip and write in a travel journal or record a video message to your future selves.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session at the house reef at sunrise — the early morning light creates magical underwater visibility and fewer people are in the water. Savor the last moments in the Maldivian ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out formalities and luggage storage with the resort. Spend the last hours at the resort's pool or beach. Browse the resort boutique for any last-minute souvenirs. Enjoy a farewell cocktail at the beach bar.
day_by_day.evening: Depending on departure flight schedule: transfer back to Velana International Airport via speedboat or seaplane. Enjoy duty-free shopping at the airport. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — make it special with a full buffet spread and a fresh juice toast to the Maldives
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort before checkout — fish and chips, tropical salad, and a mocktail (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or lounge dining depending on flight schedule — international cuisine options available at Velana International Airport (~$20–35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm speedboat or seaplane transfer timing with the resort at least 24 hours before departure. Allow extra time for transfers as Maldivian island hopping can be affected by weather. Keep passports and travel documents easily accessible. Take one last look at the turquoise lagoon — you'll want to remember it forever.

day_by_day.morning: If your return flight is on this day, enjoy the airport lounge or transit area. Alternatively, if you have a late departure, explore Malé city briefly — visit the Grand Friday Mosque, the Maldives National Museum, and the colorful local fish market for a final taste of authentic Maldivian culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Malé city exploration (if time permits) — walk along the waterfront promenade, browse the local market for dried fish, spices, and handicrafts, and enjoy a local café for authentic Maldivian short eats. Board your return flight refreshed and full of beautiful memories.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — board your return flight home carrying memories of sunsets over the Indian Ocean, glowing bioluminescent seas, and the most romantic escape imaginable.

meals.breakfast: Airport café or hotel breakfast if staying near the airport — continental spread (~$15–25 per person)
meals.lunch: Local Malé restaurant — authentic Maldivian fish curry, roshi bread, and sweet black tea (~$8–15 per person for a genuine local experience)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Malé is a short 20-minute speedboat ride from the airport island of Hulhumalé. Dress modestly when visiting the mosque and market areas. The local fish market is most vibrant in the morning hours. Exchange any remaining Maldivian Rufiyaa back to USD at the airport as it is not widely convertible abroad. Safe travels and congratulations on your honeymoon!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise. Sip champagne while watching the sky turn shades of orange and pink over the Indian Ocean. Many resorts offer this as a signature romantic experience, perfect for honeymooners seeking an intimate moment on the water.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most famous and vibrant coral reefs, teeming with parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and colorful soft corals. Banana Reef is ideal for snorkelers of all levels and offers breathtaking underwater scenery just a short boat ride from Malé. Guided snorkeling tours ensure you spot the best marine life safely.

experiences.name: Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa ritual set over the turquoise lagoon in a glass-floored overwater treatment pavilion. Enjoy traditional Maldivian coconut oil massages, flower baths, and aromatherapy scrubs while listening to the gentle lapping of the ocean below. This quintessential luxury experience is a must for honeymooners seeking ultimate relaxation.
experiences.location: South Malé Atoll, Olhuveli or Anantara Dhigu Resort

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class and Local Cuisine Tasting
experiences.description: Dive into the rich culinary culture of the Maldives with a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa short eats. Finish with a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach featuring your freshly prepared Maldivian feast paired with tropical fruit juices.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience
experiences.description: Wade into the warm Indian Ocean after dark to witness the magical phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the water with an ethereal blue glow. This rare and romantic natural spectacle is one of the most unforgettable experiences in the Maldives, perfect for honeymooners. A guided naturalist accompanies you to ensure safety and explain the science behind this natural wonder.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrival at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Meet your private Aegean Bliss Resort transfer coordinator at the arrivals hall. Board a luxury speedboat or seaplane transfer (if arranged) to the resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional Maldivian welcome with flower garlands, chilled towels, and a welcome drink. Check into your Beachfront villa, receive a private villa orientation, and unwind with a complimentary bottle of chilled champagne and a fruit platter prepared by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Light in-villa dining: charcuterie board, tropical fruit platter, and champagne provided by the resort upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, no formal activities are planned. Request early check-in luggage handling and ensure all villa amenities are pre-arranged before arrival. Confirm speedboat/seaplane transfer 48 hours in advance. The resort's concierge should be briefed on honeymoon/romance preferences for personalized touches.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast on your beachfront villa deck overlooking the Indian Ocean. Take a gentle morning stroll along the pristine white sand beach surrounding the resort, familiarizing yourself with the property. Visit the resort's welcome briefing with your personal butler to plan the days ahead and explore the resort's lagoon by stand-up paddleboard or kayak (complimentary for villa guests).
day_by_day.afternoon: Settle into the luxury of your surroundings with an afternoon at the resort's infinity pool and beach club. Enjoy a curated selection of tropical cocktails and fresh juices from the poolside bar. Take a leisurely swim in the crystal-clear lagoon directly in front of your beachfront villa. Optional: Book a private snorkeling orientation with the resort's marine biologist to preview the house reef before tomorrow's full excursion.
day_by_day.evening: Embark on the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board a beautifully decorated traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni adorned with fresh tropical flowers and candles. Drift across the golden lagoon as the sun melts into the horizon, sipping premium champagne and enjoying canapés prepared by the resort's chef. Return to the resort for a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's signature overwater restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Private beachfront breakfast at your villa — freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit, eggs cooked to order, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian tea or premium coffee
meals.lunch: Beach Club Grill: grilled lobster salad, mezze platter, and fresh coconut water served at your sun lounger
meals.dinner: Overwater Signature Restaurant: five-course tasting menu featuring locally sourced yellowfin tuna tartare, lobster bisque, grilled reef fish with coconut curry sauce, and a passion fruit soufflé for dessert

day_by_day.notes: This is your first full day — keep it relaxed and resort-focused to recover from travel. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise should be booked through the concierge the morning of Day 2. Request rose petals and a personalized honeymoon message on the dhoni for an extra romantic touch.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for the Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef — one of the Maldives' most iconic dive sites, teeming with vibrant parrotfish, moray eels, Napoleon wrasse, and stunning coral formations. Board a private chartered speedboat from the resort's jetty with a certified snorkeling guide. Spend 2–3 hours exploring the reef's diverse marine ecosystem at a relaxed, romantic pace with just the two of you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely lunch followed by an indulgent afternoon at the resort's overwater spa. Book the Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two — a luxurious couples' ritual set over the turquoise lagoon in a glass-floored treatment room. Enjoy synchronized deep-tissue massages, a traditional Maldivian scrub using coconut and sea salt, and a floral bath soak with panoramic ocean views beneath you.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's beachside restaurant under the stars with a specially curated seafood barbecue menu. Enjoy a private table set on the sand with tiki torches, personalized menu cards, and a dedicated sommelier pairing wines with each course. End the evening with a moonlit walk along the beach and a nightcap of aged rum cocktails at the resort's beach bar.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, acai bowls, artisan bread, and a Maldivian spiced tea
meals.lunch: Resort lagoon-side café: chilled prawn cocktail, grilled snapper with mango salsa, and a refreshing watermelon and mint granita
meals.dinner: Private beachside seafood BBQ: whole grilled lobster, tiger prawns, octopus skewers, and grilled reef fish with a curated wine pairing from the resort's cellar

day_by_day.notes: Banana Reef excursion requires advance booking through the concierge. Confirm departure time the evening before. The spa treatment for two is highly sought after — book at least 2 days in advance. Bring reef-safe sunscreen for the snorkeling excursion.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning on your private beachfront terrace. Participate in a guided sunrise yoga session on the beach led by the resort's wellness instructor — a deeply calming experience as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Follow with a dip in your private plunge pool (if available) or the lagoon before a nourishing breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the underwater world further with a private guided snorkeling session on the resort's house reef. Discover sea turtles, reef sharks, and schools of tropical fish just steps from your villa. In the late afternoon, visit the resort's boutique and explore local Maldivian handicrafts and souvenirs. Optionally, arrange a private visit to a local inhabited island nearby to experience authentic Maldivian culture, architecture, and village life.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic in-villa private dining experience set up by your personal butler on your beachfront deck. A private chef will prepare a bespoke five-course dinner tailored to your preferences, complete with candles, flower arrangements, and a curated wine selection. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean as you dine in complete privacy.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant: wellness breakfast spread — smoothie bowls, overnight oats, avocado toast with poached eggs, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Overwater bar and grill: lobster rolls, truffle fries, and chilled rosé wine
meals.dinner: Private in-villa chef's dinner: amuse-bouche, tuna sashimi with ponzu, seared scallops, butter-poached lobster tail, and a dark chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Request the private chef's dinner at least 24 hours in advance to allow menu customization. The local island visit typically takes 2–3 hours and can be arranged via the resort's excursion desk. Bring modest clothing (covered shoulders and knees) for the local island visit out of cultural respect.

day_by_day.morning: Participate in the Maldivian Cooking Class and Local Cuisine Tasting — a hands-on culinary experience led by a local chef at the resort's dedicated cooking studio. Learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as mas huni (smoked tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (tuna broth), and hedhikaa (local snacks). Discover the spices, fishing traditions, and cultural stories behind each dish.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cooking class, enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the resort's beach club. Indulge in a refreshing spa treatment — choose from a selection of express treatments such as a Maldivian coconut oil scalp massage or a cooling aloe vera after-sun treatment at the resort's spa. Spend time relaxing in the resort's overwater hammocks, sipping on fresh coconut water.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant, showcasing the best of pan-Asian cuisine with a Maldivian twist. Begin with sushi and sashimi platters, followed by Thai green curry with locally caught reef fish and a Japanese-inspired dessert. After dinner, enjoy cocktails at the resort's rooftop bar with panoramic 360-degree ocean views.

meals.breakfast: Cooking class participants' breakfast: fresh mas huni with roshi flatbread and black tea — a traditional Maldivian breakfast served at the start of the class
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes you prepared during the cooking class as a private tasting lunch with wine pairings selected by the resort sommelier
meals.dinner: Resort Asian Fusion Restaurant: omakase sushi selection, miso-glazed black cod, wagyu beef tataki, and green tea mochi ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is approximately 3 hours long and is one of the most culturally enriching experiences available. Confirm participation numbers with the concierge. The rooftop bar is a popular spot — arrive early to secure the best sunset-facing seats.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning on a private sandbank picnic excursion — your butler arranges a private speedboat transfer to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean. Enjoy a gourmet champagne breakfast picnic set up with sun loungers, a parasol, chilled beverages, and fresh tropical fruits as you wade in warm, knee-deep crystal water with no one else around.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a tranquil afternoon of leisure. Explore the resort's private lagoon on a glass-bottom kayak to observe the marine life below without getting wet. In the late afternoon, treat yourselves to a second Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two, this time focusing on a traditional Javanese lulur ritual — a full-body scrub using turmeric, rice, and jasmine followed by a moisturizing yogurt wrap.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a private Maldivian cultural performance arranged by the resort — featuring traditional Bodu Beru drumming and dancing. Dine at the resort's Mediterranean restaurant with a menu inspired by the flavors of the Aegean Sea, perfectly complementing the resort's theme. Pair your meal with a selection from the resort's extensive wine cellar.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank champagne picnic breakfast: smoked salmon bagels, fresh tropical fruit platters, pastries, orange juice, and Moët & Chandon champagne
meals.lunch: Resort pool bar: light bites — caprese salad, bruschetta, and a charcuterie board with premium Italian meats and cheeses
meals.dinner: Resort Mediterranean Restaurant: mezze sharing platter, grilled octopus with lemon and olive oil, lamb chops with tzatziki, and baklava with honey ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The private sandbank picnic is weather-dependent and must be booked 48 hours in advance. The resort can arrange a photographer to accompany you to the sandbank for a private couples' photoshoot — an unforgettable honeymoon keepsake.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a deep relaxation and wellness experience. Begin with a private guided meditation session on the beach at sunrise. Follow with an extended couples' yoga and breathwork class with the resort's wellness guru. Spend the remainder of the morning floating in the lagoon or simply lounging on your private beachfront terrace with books, music, and fresh juices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's marine conservation program — join the resort's resident marine biologist for an educational coral reef restoration session where you can plant a coral fragment on the reef as a symbol of your honeymoon. This is a deeply meaningful and unique activity that contributes to the Maldives' reef preservation efforts. Receive a certificate and GPS coordinates of your personal coral planting site.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the midpoint of your honeymoon with the Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — wade into the warm Indian Ocean after dark to witness the magical, otherworldly glow of bioluminescent plankton illuminating the water around you. A certified guide accompanies you for safety. Return to the resort for a late-night romantic dinner under the stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa wellness breakfast: green smoothies, chia pudding, fresh fruit, and herbal teas delivered to your terrace
meals.lunch: Beach Club: grilled fish tacos, guacamole, pico de gallo, and fresh lime agua fresca
meals.dinner: Late-night post-bioluminescence dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant: chilled oysters, butter-poached prawns, pan-seared reef fish, and a decadent chocolate and raspberry tart

day_by_day.notes: Bioluminescent snorkeling is best experienced on nights with a new moon (minimal moonlight). Confirm the lunar calendar with the resort to optimize your experience. The coral planting activity is a resort signature experience — book through the marine biology center at least 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full morning of snorkeling on the resort's house reef, this time with underwater cameras provided by the resort to capture your own photos and videos of the marine life. Focus on areas you haven't explored yet — look for octopus, lionfish, and eagle rays in the deeper sections of the reef. Rinse off and enjoy a refreshing morning smoothie at the beach bar.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a luxury afternoon at the resort's overwater spa — choose individual treatments from the spa menu. Options include a deep-tissue sports massage, a Balinese massage, a gold facial, or a hydrotherapy circuit. Spend the late afternoon in the resort's thermal suite, featuring a steam room, sauna, and cold plunge pool with ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a private wine and cheese tasting experience curated by the resort's sommelier — sample six premium wines from around the world paired with artisan cheeses, cured meats, and accompaniments in the resort's private wine cellar. Follow with a casual dinner at the resort's casual-chic beachfront bistro.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant: full English-style breakfast with Maldivian additions — fried eggs, bacon, grilled tomatoes, baked beans, and fresh roshi bread with coconut jam
meals.lunch: Overwater bar: seared ahi tuna bowl with edamame, pickled ginger, and sesame dressing
meals.dinner: Resort Beachfront Bistro: wood-fired pizza with truffle oil and burrata, arugula salad with shaved parmesan, and a tiramisu for two

day_by_day.notes: The wine and cheese tasting experience accommodates up to 6 guests but can be arranged exclusively for two. Pre-select your wine preferences (red, white, sparkling, or mixed) when booking. Underwater camera hire should be arranged the evening before through the dive center.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a second Coral Reef Snorkeling at Banana Reef excursion, this time at a different section of the reef to discover new marine life and coral formations. Explore the reef at a deeper level with the option of adding a guided freediving session if either of you is interested — the resort's instructors can provide a 30-minute introduction to freediving techniques.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend a relaxed afternoon on the beach. Arrange a private couples' photography session on the beach and in the lagoon with the resort's professional photographer — capturing candid honeymoon moments in the golden afternoon light. These photos will become treasured memories of your trip.
day_by_day.evening: Recreate the magic of the Sunset Dhoni Cruise for a second time — this time request a different route through the lagoon's channels and sandbanks, with a private sushi and sashimi spread instead of canapés. Watch the sunset from a different vantage point and enjoy the tranquility of the open ocean at dusk.

meals.breakfast: In-villa continental breakfast: fresh croissants, Danish pastries, tropical fruit, yogurt, and a French press coffee
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort: grilled tiger prawns with garlic butter, Caesar salad, and fresh lemonade
meals.dinner: On the Dhoni: premium sushi and sashimi platter with sake and champagne, followed by a late dinner at the resort's teppanyaki counter

day_by_day.notes: The professional photography session typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and final edited photos are delivered digitally within 48 hours. Request the golden hour time slot (approximately 1 hour before sunset) for the best natural lighting. The freediving session is optional and subject to individual comfort levels.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a completely free and unstructured morning — sleep in, order a lavish room service breakfast, and spend time in your private beachfront villa enjoying each other's company. Take a slow walk along the beach collecting shells, swim in the lagoon, or simply read and relax on your sun loungers. This is a day to recharge and enjoy the pure luxury of doing nothing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's overwater spa for the final Overwater Bungalow Spa Treatment for Two — choose the resort's signature 'Ocean Harmony' ritual, a comprehensive 3-hour treatment featuring a full-body exfoliation, hot stone massage, scalp treatment, and a private floral bath drawn in your overwater treatment room with views of the turquoise lagoon below.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your penultimate full week of the trip with a surprise romantic dinner arranged by your butler — a private table set on a floating pontoon in the lagoon, surrounded by floating candles and flower petals, with a dedicated chef and waiter serving a seven-course degustation menu. Toast with a bottle of vintage Dom Pérignon.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious in-villa room service: eggs royale, smoked salmon platter, warm brioche, fresh orange juice, and a pot of Maldivian spiced chai
meals.lunch: Beach Club: club sandwich with truffle mayo, sweet potato fries, and a freshly blended mango lassi
meals.dinner: Private floating pontoon dinner: seven-course degustation menu — oysters with champagne mignonette, lobster bisque, seared foie gras, yuzu sorbet palate cleanser, wagyu beef tenderloin, artisan cheese selection, and a dark chocolate and raspberry dessert

day_by_day.notes: The floating pontoon dinner is the resort's most exclusive dining experience and must be booked at least 3 days in advance. It is weather-dependent. Inform the concierge of any dietary restrictions or allergies when booking. This evening is ideal for exchanging personal vows renewal or surprise gifts if desired.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise fishing excursion on a traditional Maldivian dhoni — experience the local fishing tradition of line fishing in the open ocean as the sun rises. Any catch can be brought back to the resort's chef to be prepared as a personalized lunch dish. This is a deeply authentic and memorable Maldivian experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon revisiting your favorite spots around the resort — whether it's the house reef, the infinity pool, the overwater hammocks, or your private beachfront terrace. Visit the resort's boutique for last-minute luxury souvenirs, locally made jewelry, or bespoke Maldivian gifts. Arrange for any purchases to be gift-wrapped and shipped home if needed.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final Bioluminescent Night Snorkeling Experience — a second opportunity to witness this magical natural phenomenon, ideally on a darker night for maximum visibility. Return to the resort for a celebratory dinner at the resort's fine dining flagship restaurant, ordering from the à la carte menu with a full sommelier wine pairing service.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast: energy bars, fresh fruit, and coffee/tea served on the dhoni before departure
meals.lunch: Chef's preparation of your morning catch: grilled fresh-caught reef fish with herb butter, roasted vegetables, and a side of coconut rice — served at your beachside table
meals.dinner: Resort Flagship Fine Dining Restaurant: à la carte selection with full sommelier wine pairing — recommended dishes include the caviar service, butter-poached Maine lobster, and the signature chocolate sphere dessert

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise fishing excursion departs at approximately 05:30–06:00. Confirm the exact time with the concierge the evening before. Dress warmly for the early morning ocean breeze. The bioluminescent snorkeling experience should be booked for after 21:00 for optimal plankton visibility.

day_by_day.morning: On your penultimate morning, revisit the Maldivian Cooking Class for an advanced session — this time focusing on desserts and beverages, learning to make traditional Maldivian sweets and the famous Maldivian black tea (sai) with condensed milk. Alternatively, opt for a private mixology class at the resort's bar, learning to craft signature Maldivian-inspired cocktails to recreate at home.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a final luxurious afternoon at the resort's spa and wellness center. Book the resort's 'Farewell Ritual' — a comprehensive half-day wellness journey including a hydrotherapy circuit, couples' massage, facial, and a private relaxation lounge session with ocean views. This is the perfect way to decompress and carry the serenity of the Maldives with you.
day_by_day.evening: Host a private 'Honeymoon Farewell' dinner on your beachfront villa terrace — your butler sets up an intimate table with personalized menus, a custom floral arrangement, and a curated playlist. A private chef prepares a bespoke menu of all your favorite dishes from the trip. Reflect on your incredible 13 days together over a final bottle of vintage champagne.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant: eggs made to order, fresh tropical fruit, Maldivian hedhikaa (traditional snacks), and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Post-spa light lunch at the wellness café: quinoa and roasted vegetable bowl, avocado and prawn salad, and a cold-pressed green juice
meals.dinner: Private farewell villa dinner: personalized bespoke menu curated from your favorite dishes of the trip, served by your personal butler with a vintage champagne toast

day_by_day.notes: Request a personalized honeymoon memory book or photo album from the resort concierge — many luxury resorts in the Maldives compile a curated collection of your photos and experiences as a parting gift. Confirm checkout time and departure logistics for Day 13 this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for one final sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your beachfront villa. Take a slow, nostalgic walk along the beach, collecting shells and taking photos to remember every detail. Enjoy a final leisurely breakfast at the resort before beginning the checkout process. Your personal butler assists with packing, luggage handling, and departure arrangements.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy a final swim in the lagoon, a last visit to the house reef, or simply relax at the pool bar with a farewell cocktail. The resort's concierge arranges your private speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport with ample time before your flight. Receive a traditional Maldivian farewell from the resort staff — a heartfelt send-off with flower garlands and warm wishes.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from the Maldives. Carry with you the memories of 13 extraordinary days of luxury, romance, and natural wonder. The resort can arrange airport lounge access and priority check-in assistance for a seamless and premium departure experience.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast: a grand spread at the main restaurant — freshly baked pastries, tropical fruits, made-to-order eggs, Maldivian specialties, and a farewell glass of fresh coconut water
meals.lunch: Light pre-departure lunch at the resort or airport lounge: club sandwich, fresh salad, and a sparkling water
meals.dinner: In-flight or at your next destination

day_by_day.notes: Confirm all departure logistics — speedboat/seaplane transfer, flight details, and luggage handling — the evening before with your butler. Allow at least 3 hours before your international flight for the boat transfer and airport check-in. Request a printed copy of your honeymoon itinerary and any resort-compiled memory books as keepsakes. Tip your personal butler and villa staff before departure as a gesture of appreciation for their exceptional service.

query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026
